title: Bea Millan-Windorski wears kumot-print dress to honor 'probinsyana' dreamers
summary: Philippine bet Bea Millan-Windorski paid tribute to young “probinsyanas” by donning a dress with nostalgic kumot-inspired print at one of the pre-pageant events of the 2026 Miss Universe.…

blocks.text: Philippine bet Bea Millan-Windorski paid tribute to young “probinsyanas” by donning a dress with nostalgic kumot-inspired print at one of the pre-pageant events of the 2026 Miss Universe. The Filipino-American beauty queen turned heads in a piece by Filipino fashion designer Jaggy Glarino, as seen in the photos she shared on her Facebook page on Thursday, Nov. 12.
